title: negundo aceroides subsp. interior
intro: Negundo aceroides subsp. interior, commonly known as Mexican Buckeye, is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae. It is traditionally used in Mexican folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate pain, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Negundo aceroides subsp. interior include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, antipyretic, and antimicrobial effects.
